suppress.notes: CVEs in npm transitive dependencies detected via stale backend/package-lock.json. This file is a residual artifact — the backend is Java/Maven only. Suppress until the file is removed from the repository.

Falso positivo de CPE. CVE-2026-54399 (DoS no parser HTTP/1.1) afeta o Apache HttpComponents Core 5.x (httpcore5, "5.4.2 and earlier"), um code-base distinto. O projeto usa httpcore/httpcore-nio 4.4.16 (linha 4.x, EOL), trazido transitivamente por nl.martijndwars:web-push:5.1.1 -> httpasyncclient:4.1.5. O dependency-check casou por CPE impreciso entre as duas linhas major (httpcomponents_core 4.x vs 5.x). Ref: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-54399
